title: Basic Auth Header Generator
description: Encode username:password to a Base64 Authorization header (Unicode-safe) — copy or download.
howto: The header is generated live (Unicode-safe Base64).
Copy the full header or just the encoded value.

faqs.a: The string "username:password" is UTF-8 encoded, then Base64 — matching RFC 7617.
Yes — Unicode characters are UTF-8 encoded before Base64, unlike naive btoa() use.
No — encoding happens entirely in your browser.

faqs.q: How do I use the header?
faqs.a: Send it as the Authorization header: Authorization: Basic <base64>. Most HTTP clients also accept it via a -u flag or auth option.
